title: Fix black screen or poweroff after NVIDIA driver update
summary: If your screen stays black after updating the NVIDIA driver or the machine powers off when closing X, try these workarounds.

aliases.text: machine powers off when closing x

prerequisites: You can access the system via TTY or SSH to edit files.

steps.explain: Prepend the xrandr command to your xinitrc file to force display detection on startup.
Alternatively, add the kernel parameter rcutree.gp_init_delay=1 to your bootloader configuration.
Alternatively, add 'nvidia' to the MODULES array in /etc/mkinitcpio.conf and regenerate the initramfs.

warnings: Editing bootloader or mkinitcpio requires regenerating initramfs and rebooting.
